alternatives.notes: Search for SL09ABNLCAR / SL01NLBRT / RXS11NLBLT found only focusindustries.com pages and PDFs - no retailer lists configured part numbers with images.

recommended_strategy: Fetch the 4 Store API pages (394 products). Build family key = uppercase alnum of product sku/name (e.g. "SL09", "RXP03", "DL15", "SL20SMMSM", "SL02LEDP"). For each of our SKUs take the longest family key that is a prefix of the normalized SKU (prefer LEDP/variant pages when SKU contains LEDP). Then among that product images pick one whose filename contains the finish code at the SKU end (BLT, BRS, BRT, BAR, CAR, WBR, RST, BAT...) else images[0]. Store as family-level image (flag match_level=family). Skip *_dwg / app-shot images.
blockers: No per-SKU (configured part number) images exist anywhere observed; only family images, some with finish variants.
notes: Images are full-size JPGs in wp-content/uploads (WordPress also has -600x551 etc. derivatives). No anti-bot observed.
